user.title: Set up Sameday
user.description: Sameday tracking needs no account or postal code. Pick the country your parcels ship in — the same tracking works on Sameday's Romanian, Hungarian and Bulgarian networks. Add parcels afterwards via the integration options or the `sameday.track_parcel` service.

data_description.country: The Sameday network your parcels ship in. This picks the tracking host and cannot be changed later without removing and re-adding the integration.

data_description.add: Enter a Sameday tracking code to start tracking it. You find it on the shipping confirmation or the missed-delivery card.

data_description.delivered_filter_type: Show delivered parcels from the last X days, or limit to the X most recent.
data_description.delivered_filter_amount: Number of days or parcels to show.

data_description.include_history: Add a per-parcel history attribute listing each status update (timestamp, status, original text). Off by default.

data_description.refresh_interval: How often the integration checks Sameday for parcel updates. A slower interval is gentler on Sameday's API; the default of 30 minutes is plenty for most parcels.

error.invalid_tracking_code: That does not look like a Sameday tracking code.
error.already_tracked: That parcel is already being tracked.

track_parcel.name: Track parcel
track_parcel.description: Start tracking a parcel by its Sameday tracking code.

untrack_parcel.name: Untrack parcel
untrack_parcel.description: Stop tracking a parcel by its Sameday tracking code.

tracking_code.name: Tracking code
tracking_code.description: The Sameday tracking code to stop tracking.

trigger_type.parcel_delivery_time_changed: A parcel's expected delivery time changed
